item.description: Here's your Woodchuck Weather. Expect high temperatures today ranging from forty-nine to fifty-one degrees and lows tonight between thirty-five and thirty-nine, with skies mostly cloudy across the region. Rain showers are likely in the Champlain Valley and Essex County, with a chance for showers in other areas mainly this afternoon and evening. Most locations will see precipitation taper off overnight, leaving skies mostly cloudy through tonight.
